artworks.title: Title Page
artworks.artist: Claes Jansz Visscher after Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder after Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a figure standing on the right playing bagpipes. Behind them is a winding path, a large tree, and a small church-like structure in the distance on the left. A cartwheel rests against a gate. The engraving showcases fine lines depicting textures of clothing, tree leaves, and a thatched building. The color scheme is monochrome focusing on contrast. Latin text is displayed on a board near the figure.

artworks.title: Town Gate
artworks.artist: Claes Jansz Visscher after Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder after Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image displays a tall, medieval-style tower on the right side. The horizon is low, with buildings extending into the distance on the left. The artwork is executed in pen and ink with intricate, precise lines and cross-hatching for texture. The color scheme is monochromatic with black ink on a light paper background, highlighting the details. Two small figures walk along a path with a waterway nearby reflecting the buildings, and ducks are on the water. The sky has a few birds and wispy clouds.

artworks.title: Village Road
artworks.artist: Claes Jansz Visscher after Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder after Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with a path leading to village structures surrounded by trees and shrubs. The etching technique features fine lines and shading for texture of thatched roofs and trees. The color palette is monochromatic, mainly black and beige. Birds can be seen in the sky.

artworks.title: Village Road
artworks.artist: Claes Jansz Visscher after Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder after Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a dirt path leading into a wooded area. The horizon is low, and a small figure is walking along the path. Three thatched-roof buildings are to the right. The trees and foliage are detailed with fine lines, creating texture. The color palette is monochromatic with black ink on a light backdrop. Bushes and trees are on the left. In the lower right corner, a small figure on horseback is accompanied by a dog.

artworks.title: A Farmyard
artworks.artist: Claes Jansz Visscher after Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder after Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a cluster of thatched roof buildings surrounded by trees. The viewpoint is from ground level, highlighting the roofs, trees, and sky. The artwork appears to be an intricate pen and ink drawing with detailed line work showing textures. The color scheme is monochromatic, using black and gray on a light background. A path leads through the village, partially hidden by trees, towards more buildings and trees in the distance. The scene portrays a quiet rural setting with a focus on architectural and natural details.

artworks.title: The Swann's Inn
artworks.artist: Claes Jansz Visscher after Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder after Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image depicts a rural scene with trees, buildings, figures engaged in conversation, and a person sitting near a basket. One of the buildings has a round emblem with a rooster on it, and there are trees surrounding the area. The sketch is done in fine, precise lines typical of etching, creating texture and shade. The color palette is monochromatic, with black ink on a light background.

artworks.title: Village Road
artworks.artist: Claes Jansz Visscher after Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder after Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with a dirt path leading from the foreground towards a village in the distance. The horizon is low, showcasing the sky with flying birds. In the center, thatched-roof houses are surrounded by detailed trees. The artwork is monochromatic, emphasizing textures and details. A group of figures is gathered near the path.

artworks.title: Farms in a Village
artworks.artist: Claes Jansz Visscher after Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder after Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with thatched-roofed buildings in a village. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, showing the village against the sky. The artwork uses fine etching lines for detail and texture. The lines vary in density to show shading and texture, especially on the roofs and foliage. The color palette is monochromatic, with black lines on a light background. A man is seen drawing water from a well, with a dog nearby. More buildings and trees are visible, creating a dense village setting.

artworks.title: The Pond
artworks.artist: Claes Jansz Visscher after Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder after Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a village with a stone tower at its center and thatched houses lined up beyond it. The scene is depicted with fine etching strokes, creating texture and shadow. The color palette is monochrome, with black ink on light paper. In the foreground, there is a pond with a figure fishing, and a boat nearby. In the background, there are trees, with birds flying in the sky.

artworks.title: Large Farm
artworks.artist: Claes Jansz Visscher after Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder after Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with rural buildings, trees, and a sky with clouds. The roofs of the buildings are visible from a slightly elevated perspective. Trees of various heights partially obstruct the view of the buildings. The horizon is marked by a line of trees. The sky above has clouds and birds in motion. The image is created using an etching technique, with fine lines detailing texture and depth. The color scheme is monochromatic, using black lines on a cream background to depict light and shadow. A dirt path in the foreground adds depth to the composition.

artworks.title: Walled Farm
artworks.artist: Claes Jansz Visscher after Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder after Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image displays a rustic scene with gabled-roof buildings within a stone wall enclosure. Trees line the horizon beyond the buildings. The drawing style is detailed, with cross-hatching for texture. The color scheme is mainly black, gray, and beige. A path leads to the gates with trees framing the entrance. The sky contains clouds and distant birds.

artworks.title: Village Road
artworks.artist: Claes Jansz Visscher after Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes after Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene from a slightly elevated angle. The sky occupies a significant part of the image, featuring delicate lines suggesting clouds. Birds are seen near the horizon. In the foreground, there is a winding dirt path leading to thatched-roof buildings surrounded by fences and trees. The trees are detailed with cross-hatching. A figure is visible near the path. The image is in black and white, resembling an etching with precise line work defining the landscape.

artworks.title: A Convent
artworks.artist: Claes Jansz Visscher after Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder after Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The artwork features a rural scene with two figures walking along a path. The horizon is low, showing a detailed tree line and a distant church with a spire. Trees of different heights and densities create a barrier before the structures. The linework style is detailed with cross-hatchings and parallel lines. The monochromatic palette uses various shades for contrast. The sky is lightly detailed with cloud shapes, and small birds fly in the distance.

artworks.title: Village Road
artworks.artist: Claes Jansz Visscher after Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder after Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image features a detailed engraving of a rural landscape. The scene includes a path leading into the distance, surrounded by trees and rustic buildings. Two figures are walking on the path, one herding animals. The trees and buildings are intricately depicted with delicate lines. The monochrome color palette contrasts black ink lines on a pale background. The sky is lightly shaded with birds in flight, creating a tranquil atmosphere.

artworks.title: Pond and a Village
artworks.artist: Claes Jansz Visscher after Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder after Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a view of a river with a village in the background. Two figures are rowing a boat on the water, and a bridge leads to the village. The trees are depicted with cross-hatching. The artwork is done in black ink on beige paper.

artworks.title: Road along a Field
artworks.artist: Claes Jansz Visscher after Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder after Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a rural landscape from an elevated perspective. The horizon is high with trees, buildings, and fields. The brushstrokes are fine and detailed, creating a textured appearance. The color palette is monochromatic with varying shades of brown. Two figures are interacting beside a stream, one kneeling and the other on horseback. A path winds through fields towards village buildings. In the distance, cottages with thatched roofs and a fenced area are visible. Sparse clouds and a few birds are in the sky.

artworks.title: Landscape with Hewed Trees
artworks.artist: Claes Jansz Visscher after Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder after Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral village landscape from a slight elevation. The horizon is high in the composition, with trees and rooftops blending into the sky. There are cottages with thatched roofs among trees. Two figures interact near trees, with logs nearby. The intricate foliage is depicted with detailed line work. The artwork features a monochromatic color palette with dark ink on a light background. Trees in the background recede in size, adding depth. The scene conveys a tranquil rural life through stippling and cross-hatching techniques.

artworks.title: A Pond
artworks.artist: Claes Jansz Visscher after Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder after Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image features a rural landscape with a pond near the foreground where cattle and birds are present. There are two figures standing by the pond. A row of trees leads to rustic buildings in the background, likely a farmhouse or cottages. The horizon is defined by dense foliage and trees. The etching technique is visible in fine details and cross-hatched strokes, adding texture to the trees and buildings. The monochrome palette consists of sepia or earth tones, creating a timeless atmosphere. The sky is lightly sketched with a few small birds.

artworks.title: Road into a Village
artworks.artist: Claes Jansz Visscher after Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder after Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral village scene with figures walking, pulling a sled, and buildings with thatched roofs surrounded by trees. The sky has scattered clouds and flying birds. The composition is elevated, emphasizing the sky and landscape. The details are depicted in fine, linear brushstrokes typical of an etching, creating a monochromatic color palette.

artworks.title: Village Road
artworks.artist: Claes Jansz Visscher after Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder after Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with a small settlement. Trees, houses, birds, and people are depicted in a detailed, etched style. The color palette is sepia or black and white, creating a rustic and historical vibe. In the foreground, figures and animals are visible, with thatched structures in the background.

artworks.title: Large Sheds
artworks.artist: Claes Jansz Visscher after Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder after Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a rustic landscape with a linear style, featuring a horizon near the top third. Distant buildings and trees are silhouetted along the horizon. In the foreground, there is a path passing by thatched-roof huts detailed with texture and shadow. The monochromatic color palette creates contrast between dark ink lines and lighter paper. Cross-hatching and parallel lines are used for depth and detail. Trees, birds, and a slightly cloudy sky complete the scene.

artworks.title: A Castle
artworks.artist: Claes Jansz Visscher after Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder after Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: There is an image of a castle scene. The castle is off-center to the right, with towers and gabled roofs. The horizon is obscured by trees, giving depth. The illustration is detailed and monochromatic, with a limited color palette of black and brown. The ground shows swirling lines that could represent water or a path. The castle is surrounded by detailed trees. There are small figures near the castle. Birds are seen in the sky.

artworks.title: Large Walled Farm
artworks.artist: Claes Jansz Visscher after Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder after Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with rustic buildings, trees, and a wooden fence. The viewpoint is slightly elevated. The scene features detailed lines depicting the textures of the buildings and trees. The image is in black and white, emphasizing light and shadow contrast. In the foreground, two goats stand on bare soil, and a person walks with a stick. The composition leads the eye from the animals and figure towards the central house. In the background, birds fly in the sky.

artworks.title: Fields and a Road
artworks.artist: Claes Jansz Visscher after Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder after Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image depicts a rural landscape with an elevated viewpoint showing a village in the distance. The horizon is low in the composition, with windmills and buildings lining it. The etching technique used intricate lines to define structures, figures, and natural elements. The color scheme is monochromatic, using black and white for contrast. A path runs through fields with figures walking on it. In the background, thatched-roofed houses are surrounded by trees, under a sky with light clouds.
